title: Weighing Evidence Across Studies
endLine: Weight studies by precision, not votes, to measure the shared effect.

scenes.tts: When studies disagree, which answer should you trust? Some report a large shift, others see little change, and a few lean the opposite way. Simply counting which side has more studies treats noisy results like sharp ones. Meta-analysis combines their measurements instead of counting votes.
scenes.caption: When studies disagree, which answer should you trust? Some report a large shift, others see little change, and a few lean the opposite way. Simply counting which side has more studies treats noisy results like sharp ones. Meta-analysis combines their measurements instead of counting votes.
scenes.visual: Schematic. Full-frame dark canvas with a bright horizontal axis centred on a vertical dashed line labelled '0'. Before the voice finishes the question, study dots with horizontal bars of mixed widths appear across the axis—several to the right, some near zero, a few to the left—drifting gently. As 'which answer should you trust?' is spoken, a bright question mark pulses below the axis. On 'Simply counting', simple tally marks briefly flash beside left and right before dissolving as the bars glide toward a single pooled marker.
scenes.narration: When studies disagree, which answer should you trust? Some report a large shift, others see little change, and a few lean the opposite way. Simply counting which side has more studies treats noisy results like sharp ones. Meta-analysis combines their measurements instead of counting votes.

scenes.visual: Schematic. The scattered study dots and bars align smoothly into neat horizontal rows above the same zero line while the title 'Weighing Evidence Across Studies' fades in boldly near the top, holds briefly with gentle bar shimmer, and fades out.

scenes.tts: Before pooling numbers, you must gather studies fairly. That starts with a systematic review, a strict search for every study fitting preset rules. You set rules before seeing results, so you cannot cherry-pick favorite outcomes. Each matching study yields one comparable number, its effect size, measuring how big the change was.
scenes.caption: Before pooling numbers, you must gather studies fairly. That starts with a systematic review, a strict search for every study fitting preset rules. You set rules before seeing results, so you cannot cherry-pick favorite outcomes. Each matching study yields one comparable number, its effect size, measuring how big the change was.
scenes.visual: Schematic. Above the carried horizontal zero-line axis, study cards drift downward toward a glowing filter gate labelled 'preset rules'. Cards that match pass cleanly through while non-matching cards slide away to the edge; a lock icon closes on the gate as 'before seeing results' is spoken. Each accepted card shrinks into a bright dot positioned along the axis at its effect size, with a subtle continuous pulse.
scenes.narration: Before pooling numbers, you must gather studies fairly. That starts with a systematic review, a strict search for every study fitting preset rules. You set rules before seeing results, so you cannot cherry-pick favorite outcomes. Each matching study yields one comparable number, its effect size, measuring how big the change was.

scenes.tts: Each effect size also carries a horizontal bar showing its uncertainty. Stacked above one shared axis, these rows form a forest plot. A narrow bar means high precision, because random scatter is small. A wide bar means low precision and a noisy estimate.
scenes.caption: Each effect size also carries a horizontal bar showing its uncertainty. Stacked above one shared axis, these rows form a forest plot. A narrow bar means high precision, because random scatter is small. A wide bar means low precision and a noisy estimate.
scenes.visual: Schematic. On the same stacked rows, horizontal uncertainty bars extend symmetrically from every dot before 'uncertainty' is named, turning the layout into a full-height forest plot labelled 'forest plot'. One narrow-bar row highlights brightly with tight jittering ticks ('high precision'), then a wide-bar row highlights in a softer tone with broad gently oscillating ticks ('low precision').
scenes.narration: Each effect size also carries a horizontal bar showing its uncertainty. Stacked above one shared axis, these rows form a forest plot. A narrow bar means high precision, because random scatter is small. A wide bar means low precision and a noisy estimate.

scenes.tts: Precision sets each study's weight. Narrow bars earn large weights, and wide bars earn small ones. Multiply each effect size by its weight, sum them, and divide by the total weight. Meta-analysis weights studies by precision, so sharp measurements pull the pooled diamond more than noisy ones.
scenes.caption: Precision sets each study's weight. Narrow bars earn large weights, and wide bars earn small ones. Multiply each effect size by its weight, sum them, and divide by the total weight. Meta-analysis weights studies by precision, so sharp measurements pull the pooled diamond more than noisy ones.
scenes.visual: Schematic. Each dot on the forest plot transforms into a square whose area scales with precision: narrow-bar squares grow bold and large while wide-bar squares shrink small. As the formula is spoken, 'pooled = sum(weight × effect) / sum(weight)' builds piece by piece near the top in bright type. Glowing tether lines pull from each square to a bright summary diamond below the axis, with thick tethers from narrow bars pulling the diamond steadily into place.
scenes.narration: Precision sets each study's weight. Narrow bars earn large weights, and wide bars earn small ones. Multiply each effect size by its weight, sum them, and divide by the total weight. Meta-analysis weights studies by precision, so sharp measurements pull the pooled diamond more than noisy ones.

scenes.tts: Now test this rule on a forest plot. Most rows are noisy studies with wide bars near zero. Only a few rows have tight bars clearly to the right. If you weight by precision instead of counting votes, where does the pooled diamond land?
scenes.caption: Now test this rule on a forest plot. Most rows are noisy studies with wide bars near zero. Only a few rows have tight bars clearly to the right. If you weight by precision instead of counting votes, where does the pooled diamond land?
scenes.visual: Schematic. The same forest plot reconfigures smoothly: many wide-bar rows with small squares cluster near the dashed zero line, while a few tight-bar rows with large squares sit clearly to the right of zero. The question 'Where does the pooled diamond land?' appears cleanly at the top, and two hollow candidate diamond outlines appear below the axis—one near zero and one to the right.
scenes.narration: Now test this rule on a forest plot. Most rows are noisy studies with wide bars near zero. Only a few rows have tight bars clearly to the right. If you weight by precision instead of counting votes, where does the pooled diamond land?

scenes.visual: Schematic. Thinking pause: the forest plot and the question 'Where does the pooled diamond land?' remain on screen while the bars shimmer gently and the two candidate diamond outlines softly pulse in turn.

scenes.tts: The diamond lands clearly to the right. Although wide-bar studies outnumber sharp ones, large uncertainty shrinks each wide study's weight. A simple vote count would have missed the pattern.
scenes.caption: The diamond lands clearly to the right. Although wide-bar studies outnumber sharp ones, large uncertainty shrinks each wide study's weight. A simple vote count would have missed the pattern.
scenes.visual: Schematic. The candidate outline near zero fades as the right-hand diamond fills with bright solid colour and settles firmly right of zero. Thick glowing lines briefly connect the tight-bar squares to the filled diamond while the many wide-bar squares dim and show thin faint tethers, illustrating why vote counting misses the shift.
scenes.narration: The diamond lands clearly to the right. Although wide-bar studies outnumber sharp ones, large uncertainty shrinks each wide study's weight. A simple vote count would have missed the pattern.

scenes.tts: Still, pooling cannot rescue biased inputs. If studies with weak results stay unpublished, or one population dominates, the diamond tilts. Even clean trends across studies show correlation, not proof of cause. Reviewers guard against bias by setting search rules upfront, checking study design, and stating those limits.
scenes.caption: Still, pooling cannot rescue biased inputs. If studies with weak results stay unpublished, or one population dominates, the diamond tilts. Even clean trends across studies show correlation, not proof of cause. Reviewers guard against bias by setting search rules upfront, checking study design, and stating those limits.
scenes.visual: Schematic. On the same forest plot, several faded ghost bars drift in near the left side labelled 'unpublished', and the pooled diamond visibly shifts toward the right when they vanish. One oversized row flashes to represent a single dominant population tilting the diamond. A crisp horizontal scan sweeps across the plot as three short tags illuminate in sequence—'preset rules', 'study design', 'correlation only'—and the diamond steadies.

Even clean trends across studies show correlation, not proof of cause. Reviewers guard against bias by setting search rules upfront, checking study design, and stating those limits.

scenes.tts: In 2011, I-Ching Chen, Chris D Thomas and colleagues pooled published range shifts of terrestrial species. Shifts were greatest in studies whose regions had warmed most, a correlation across studies linking shifts to climate. In 2017, Pecl and colleagues reviewed evidence that climate-driven redistribution alters communities, ecosystem functioning, and human well-being.

scenes.visual: Schematic. The forest-plot rows morph into regional range-shift points climbing upward along a warming axis, labelled 'Chen, Thomas et al. 2011' with a clear tag 'correlation across studies'; points in warmer regions glide farthest upward. The right side expands smoothly into three linked nodes labelled 'communities', 'ecosystems', and 'well-being' tagged 'Pecl et al. 2017', with gentle flowing motion connecting them.

In 2017, Pecl and colleagues reviewed evidence that climate-driven redistribution alters communities, ecosystem functioning, and human well-being.

scenes.tts: A 2014 review gathered plant transplant tests across range borders. In forty-six percent of tests, the range limit matched a niche limit, where conditions turned unsuitable. In twenty-six percent, mostly north-south or east-west limits, transplants survived beyond the range.
scenes.caption: A 2014 review gathered plant transplant tests across range borders. In 46% of tests, the range limit matched a niche limit, where conditions turned unsuitable. In 26%, mostly north-south or east-west limits, transplants survived beyond the range.
scenes.visual: The regional plot transforms into three horizontal proportion bars computed directly from the 2014 review numbers, tagged '2014 transplant review': '46% niche limit' fills first, then '26% survived beyond range' (tagged 'mostly north-south or east-west limits').
scenes.narration: A 2014 review gathered plant transplant tests across range borders. In 46% of tests, the range limit matched a niche limit, where conditions turned unsuitable. In 26%, mostly north-south or east-west limits, transplants survived beyond the range.

scenes.tts: In twenty-three percent, all at elevation limits, ranges ran past the niche limit. The shares do not add to one hundred percent. Gathering every test turns scattered results into a clearer pattern than one study gives.
scenes.caption: In 23%, all at elevation limits, ranges ran past the niche limit. The shares do not add to 100%. Gathering every test turns scattered results into a clearer pattern than one study gives.
scenes.visual: The third bar '23% past niche limit' fills beside the first two (tagged 'all at elevation limits'), with a small note 'shares do not add to 100%'. On the final sentence, the bars resolve smoothly back into the clean forest plot with its steady glowing pooled diamond.
scenes.narration: In 23%, all at elevation limits, ranges ran past the niche limit. The shares do not add to 100%. Gathering every test turns scattered results into a clearer pattern than one study gives.

scenes.visual: The forest-plot rows fade away, leaving the steady glowing pooled diamond centred above the end card text in bright, high-contrast type: 'Weight studies by precision, not votes, to measure the shared effect.'
